come.jaymoskingdoms.promise.0: You've not forgotten? You promised to %1$s. Today's the day.
come.jaymoskingdoms.promise.1: Just making sure. You did say you'd %1$s.
come.jaymoskingdoms.promise.2: I'm holding you to it, you know. You said you'd %1$s.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.promise.0: Your promise. To %1$s. I wanted to be sure you remembered.
come.jaymoskingdoms.why.promise.1: You gave me your word. I'm only reminding you.
come.jaymoskingdoms.gist.promise: (They hold up a hand, then point at you and back at themselves: you owe them something today.)
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.94: Villagers keep their own counsel about you. How they talk to you, what they tell you and what they charge all follow from what you've done and said.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.95: A promise to a villager goes in your journal. Keep it and their family warms to you. Break it and they all hear.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.what.repay: pay back the %s I lent you
promise.jaymoskingdoms.what.speak_for: speak for me to the ruler
promise.jaymoskingdoms.handed.bring.1: Just what I needed. You're as good as your word.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.handed.repay.0: Paid in full, and on time. I'd lend to you again, %1$s.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.handed.repay.1: Honest as the day. Thank you.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.kept.come_back.0: You came back! I wasn't sure you would.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.kept.come_back.1: There you are, %1$s. Just as you said.
My little one's safe and sound. I owe you, %1$s.
They haven't stopped talking about you, %1$s. Thank you for watching them.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.kept.escort_child: You found them! Oh, thank you, %1$s.
Home safe. I can breathe again.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.kept.speak_for.0: I heard you spoke to the ruler for me. Thank you, %1$s.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.kept.speak_for.1: Word came that you put in a word for me. That means something.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.kept.keep_peace.0: You kept the peace, %1$s. I'll not forget it.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.kept.keep_peace.1: Not a hand raised. You're as good as your word.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.broken.bring.1: Never mind what you promised. I'll know better next time.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.broken.repay.1: I lent you coin in good faith. Never again.
You said you'd come back. You didn't.
I waited for you, %1$s. All day.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.broken.watch_chil: You said you'd look after my child. Where were you?
I trusted you with my little one, %1$s.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.broken.escort_chi: I had to go and fetch them myself in the end.
You said you'd bring them home, %1$s.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.broken.child_lost: You said you'd keep them safe. You said.
You never spoke to the ruler for me, did you?
So much for putting in a word, %1$s.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.broken.keep_peace: You swore you'd keep the peace. Look what you did.
Your word's worth nothing here now, %1$s.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.released.0: Well. Thank you for telling me, at least.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.released.1: I'd hoped... never mind. Better you say so.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.child_hurt: My little one came home with a cut, %1$s. You said you'd watch them.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.journal.title: A promise to %s
promise.jaymoskingdoms.journal.repay: Pay %1$s back the %2$s they lent you.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.journal.watch_chi: Look in on %2$s, %1$s's child, once each day, and keep them safe.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.journal.escort_ch: Walk %2$s home to %1$s before it gets late.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.journal.speak_for: Speak for %1$s to the ruler of %2$s: seek an audience.
promise.jaymoskingdoms.journal.keep_peac: Raise no hand and do no crime in %2$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.kept_word.0: %1$s made me a promise, and kept it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.kept_word.1: If %1$s gives you their word, you can count on it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.broke_word.0: %1$s gave me their word once. Once.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.kept_word.0: %3$s says you kept your word to them, %1$s. Good to know.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.kept_word.1: They say you're as good as your word. %3$s told me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.broke_word.0: %3$s told me you broke your word to them, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.broke_word.1: You're the one who let %3$s down. Don't make me any promises.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kept_word.0: You kept your word to me, %1$s. Not many do.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kept_word.1: I still think of how you kept your promise.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kept_word.2: You said you would, and you did. I won't forget it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.broke_word.1: I remember what you promised me. I remember you didn't do it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.broke_word.2: Your word, %1$s? I've had your word before.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.farmer_crop.ope: The wheat's slow this year. Too little rain, then too much.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.farmer_crop.a: I'll bring you what you need.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.farmer_crop.a.s: Would you? %2$s %3$s would do, by the day after tomorrow.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.farmer_crop.b: It'll come right. It always does.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.farmer_crop.b.s: Easy said by someone who doesn't eat by it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.farmer_crop.c.s: Work harder. Right. I'll remember that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.fisher_nets.ope: My nets are more hole than net. The string won't last the week.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.fisher_nets.a.s: %2$s %3$s would mend them. By the day after tomorrow, then?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.fisher_nets.b.s: Tell that to six mouths at home.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.fisher_nets.c: Ask around. Someone will have some.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.fisher_nets.c.s: Maybe. Kind of you to care.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.shepherd_wolves: Wolves took a lamb last night. That's the third this month.
I'll keep watch tonight, and come back tomorrow.
You'd do that? Come and find me tomorrow and tell me what you saw.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.fletcher_feathe: A good arrow needs good feathers, and the chickens round here are plucked bald.
%2$s %3$s, if you can. Within two days and I'll have my orders done.
Leaves. You'd make a fine fletcher.
Not many ask. A straight shaft, true feathers, and patience. Thank you for asking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.librarian_pages: Someone's torn pages out of my best book. If I find out who...
Do. And keep this between us.
I never said it was. Odd thing to say.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.cartographer_ed: My maps stop where the roads do. What's past the hills, I couldn't tell you.
I'll go and look, and come back to tell you.
Would you? Come back within three days, before I forget I asked.
Ha! Then I'll draw dragons there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.cleric_doubt.op: Some days I wonder if anyone hears my prayers.
Thank you. I needed to hear that.
Because the asking matters. I hope it does.
You must be lonely, to think that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.armorer_boast.o: No blade in this town gets through my plate. Not one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.armorer_boast.a: I'd like to test that one day.
Would you now? Bold. I like bold.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.armorer_boast.b: Have you. Where? Name the smith.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.armorer_boast.c: It is. Glad someone sees it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.weaponsmith_coa: The forge eats coal faster than the miners can dig it.
%2$s %3$s would keep her lit two more days. Bring it by then?
If you do, send them my way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.toolsmith_appre: My apprentice ran off to be a soldier. Fool boy.
If he lives. Kind of you to say it.
Good for him. Bad for me.
I'll ask the ruler to send him home.
You'd speak for me? Then do it soon. Within four days.
Something's been at my smokehouse at night. Big tracks, too.
Give me some meat and I'll bait a trap.
Here. Bring me its hide, if you get it.
A bear, probably. Leave it be.
Leave it be. While it eats my winter.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.leatherworker_h: Rabbit hide. Soft as anything. I can't get enough of it.
%2$s %3$s, within three days, and I'll make you something nice.
That's why it's worth so much.
Is cow hide not good enough?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.mason_wall.open: The town wall's cracking on the east side. Nobody listens to me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.mason_wall.a: I'll speak to the ruler for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.mason_wall.a.sa: Would you? Within four days, before it falls on someone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.mason_wall.b: I'll bring you clay to patch it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.mason_wall.b.sa: %2$s %3$s, the day after tomorrow. That would hold it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.mason_wall.c.sa: With what? Clay doesn't grow on trees.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.nitwit_fly.open: I dreamed I could fly. Do you think people can fly?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.guard_night.ope: Long night on the wall. Quiet. I don't trust quiet.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.guard_night.a: I'll walk the wall with you a while.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.guard_night.c: You look hungry. I'll bring you bread.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.guard_night.c.s: %2$s %3$s by tomorrow would see me through. Thank you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.guard_taxes.ope: The ruler wants more coin from the farms again. Not my place to say so.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.guard_taxes.b: I'll tell the ruler you said that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.child_watch.ope: %2$s runs off the moment I turn my back, and I've work to do.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.child_watch.a: I'll look in on %2$s for the next two days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.child_watch.a.s: Would you? Bless you. Two days, and I'll owe you.
Have you seen %2$s? They wandered off, and it'll be dark before long.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.partner_words.o: %2$s and I had words this morning. Over nothing, really.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.partner_words.a: Go and make it up. Life's short.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.kin_visit.open: %2$s says I never come round. They live just over there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.kin_visit.c.sai: They'd like that. They like visitors more than me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.grief_kin.open: We buried %2$s last season. Some days I still set a place for them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.grief_kin.a: I'm sorry. Tell me about them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.grief_kin.a.sai: They laughed too loud. I miss it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.grief_kin.c.sai: %3$s. If you see them, tell them I haven't forgotten.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.child_dreams.op: My little one wants to be an adventurer, like you. I'd sooner they were a baker.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.child_dreams.c: I'll teach them to use a sword.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.kid_knight.open: Are you a knight? You look like a knight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.kid_dare.open: Bet you can't jump as high as the bell.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.kid_dare.c: Go home. Your family will worry.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_same.open: You're %2$s, like me. There aren't many of us this far out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_same.a: Then we look out for each other.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_same.a.sa: Agreed. Come to me if you need anything.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_same.b.sa: Spoken like someone who's never been spat at for it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_same.c: Where does your family come from?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_same.c.sa: The old country. It's a long story. Another day.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_stares.op: People stare at me. Because I'm %2$s. Do you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_stares.b: A little. It's new to me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_yours.ope: I've never met anyone %2$s. Is it true what they say?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_yours.c.s: Do you dream like we do? Never mind. Thank you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_ember_col: The cold here gets into my bones. Back home the hearths never went out.
I'll bring you coal for your fire.
%2$s %3$s would do it. The day after tomorrow?
Why does anyone? Work. Someone I loved.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_frost_hea: Too warm here. Far too warm.
Ha! You'd be surprised how much that helps.
There isn't enough shade in the world.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_same.open: I've seen you at the shrine. %2$s keeps us both.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_other.ope: You keep %2$s, I hear. I keep %3$s. We'll not see eye to eye.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_other.a: We needn't. We can still be civil.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_other.a.s: Civil. Yes. That I can do.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_truth.ope: The Truth needs no shrine. Why kneel to %2$s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_truth.b: Why does it matter to you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_truth.b.s: Because I'd hate to see you lied to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_unsworn.o: You don't pray, do you? I can always tell.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_unsworn.c: Gladly! Come and find me tomorrow.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.faith_priest.op: A soul carries its wrongs like stones in a pocket. Have you any to set down?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_war.open: We're at war with %2$s, they say. My son's of age. What do I do?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_war.a.sai: If only the ruler thought so.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_war.b: Let him fight. It's his duty.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_war.b.sai: Easy to say when it's not your son.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_war.c: I'll ask the ruler to spare him.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_war.c.sai: You'd do that? Please. Within four days, before they march.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_ruler.ope: Have you met our ruler? What are they really like?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_ruler.b.s: Careful who hears you say that.
You're not from round here. What brings you?
Ask at the bell. There's always something.
Then I'll keep an eye on you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_sworn.ope: You're one of ours now. Funny. I remember when you were a stranger.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_taxes.ope: Taxes again. The ruler's men took half my stores.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_taxes.a: I'll bring you something to tide you over.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_taxes.a.s: %2$s %3$s, the day after tomorrow? Bless you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_roads.ope: The roads aren't what they were. My cousin's late back from market.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_roads.a: I'll look out for them, and come back to tell you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_roads.a.s: Would you? Come back within two days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.realm_roads.c.s: For someone with a sword, maybe.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_rain.a.s: That's what I keep telling myself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_rain.c: Get inside. You'll catch a cold.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_storm.op: Lightning struck the old tree last night. That's an omen, that is.
Lean in. I'll tell you what I've heard.
That's what they said last time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_night.op: Shouldn't you be indoors? Things walk at night.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_crime.op: I saw you at %2$s. I've not forgotten it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_crime.a: It won't happen again. I swear it.
Then keep the peace here for five days, and I'll believe you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_saved.op: I never thanked you properly. For that day.
There's every need. I owe you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_saved.b: You can pay me back some day.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_struck.o: You hit me. I've not forgotten.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_struck.a: Words are cheap. But they're something.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_struck.c: Then keep your hands to yourself here for a week.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_gift.ope: That gift you gave me. Why?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_gift.c.s: For what? Never mind. Thank you back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_quest.op: You did what I asked, and more. Most wouldn't.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_quest.b: I did it for the pay.
You're round here more often than my own family.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_rude.ope: You were short with me last time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.recent_rude.b.s: And you say too little worth hearing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.money_loan.open: You look short of coin. I could lend you a little.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.money_loan.a: I'd be grateful. I'll pay you back in three days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.money_loan.a.sa: %2$s, then. Three days. I'm trusting you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.secret_crook.op: Can I tell you something? Just between us?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.none.2: Can't think of a thing. Busy day.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.sulk.1: I've said all I mean to say to you today.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.manner.fond.0: %1$s's face lights up when they see you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.manner.fond.2: %1$s greets you like an old friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.manner.trusting: %1$s talks to you openly, without a glance round.
%1$s lowers their voice, as if to a friend.
%1$s doesn't hesitate to talk to you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.manner.admiring: %1$s straightens up as you come over.
%1$s looks at you with something like respect.
%1$s nods to you, a little formally.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.manner.wary.0: %1$s keeps a hand on their purse.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.manner.wary.1: %1$s watches you carefully as they speak.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.manner.scornful: %1$s doesn't bother to hide a sneer.
%1$s talks to you like a child.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.rumour.clam.0: I'd rather not say. Not to you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.rumour.crook: Keep an eye on %2$s. Light fingers, that one. You didn't hear it from me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.rumour.war: Word is %2$s are raising men. More than last time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.rumour.none.0: Nothing worth telling. It's been quiet.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.rumour.none.1: I've heard nothing, and I hear most things.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.favour.none: I've nothing to spare just now. Sorry.
You gave me your word. You didn't keep it.
I'm sorry. I'll make it right.
